title: Film title cover
description: The first slide as a film title: gold silk light flows in a living WebGL shader (warm sunlit haze on light looks), the title rises letter by letter out of a mask while it comes into focus, a gold hairline draws, the kicker scrambles in (GSAP ScrambleText). A photo or clip sits in a tall cinematic frame on the free side and slowly pushes in; a person is only framed, never tilted or covered.

props.title: required, the name of the talk, 2-8 words
props.by: who and when, one short line
props.gold: a word or words of the title to colour gold
props.src: a photo or mp4 for the tall frame
props.face: [x, y, w, h] of a face in the picture, 0 to 1
props.body: [x, y, w, h] of the person
props.pos: object-position of the picture (default: the face centre)

example.title: Motion graphics on a slide
example.sub: A real deck, made from a few lines
example.alt: A person talking to the camera
